stem.x: The figure below shows part of a cause and effect diagram (also known as a fishbone diagram). Which of the following is the relationship between A and B?

stem.alt: A horizontal arrow points right into a box labelled A. From a box labelled B below and to the left, a diagonal arrow points up and to the right, ending on the horizontal arrow (part of a fishbone diagram).

b.x: B is an attribute of A.
B is the cause of A.
